blocks.text: Lesi sitatimende sisebenza ngokufanayo ezintweni zemidiya zezinkampani zangaphandle ezisetshenziselwa ukubonisa, ukusebenzisana noma ukuhlobisa kuwebhusayithi ye-OmniCivitas kanye nekhosombe lekhodi ye-GitHub, okuhlanganisa izithombe, izithombe-mzwelo, ama-GIF, imifanekiso, iziqeshana zamavidiyo, umculo, imithelela yomsindo, amazwi nokuqukethwe okuhlobene kwesibili okucutshungulwayo.

Amalungelo okushicilela, amalungelo ophawu lwentengiso, amalungelo abadlali, amalungelo abakhiqizi bomsindo namavidiyo abathintekayo ezintweni ezingenhla, kanye nesithombe, igama, izwi namanye amalungelo ahlobene nezintshisekelo ezijatshulelwa umthetho, kungabanikazi bamalungelo abo asemthethweni ngokulandelana. Le phrojekthi ayiwatholi amalungelo ezinto zokwakha zangempela ngenxa yokuqoqwa, ukubonisa, ukuminyanisa, ukunqampuna, ukuguqulwa kwamagama noma okunye ukucubungula; amalungelo asanda kungezwa asungulwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho kokuqukethwe okucutshungulwayo kwesibili awathathi indawo yamalungelo wezinto zoqobo.

Ezinye izinto zivela ekusatshalalisweni kwenethiwekhi yesikhathi eside, futhi umshicileli wazo wangempela, umbhali, iphrosesa noma uchungechunge lobunikazi obuphelele kungenzeka zingaqinisekiswa ngendlela enokwethenjelwa. Le phrojekthi ayifuni okoqobo okungaziwa njengokwangempela, okunikezwe ilayisense, noma okusendaweni yomphakathi. Iqiniso lokuthi indaba isatshalaliswa kabanzi, inesinqumo esiphansi, futhi isiphinde yakhiqizwa izikhathi eziningi akusho ukuthi amalungelo afanelekile asephelelwe yisikhathi.

Le phrojekthi iwukuhlolwa komuntu siqu kobuchwepheshe obungenzi nzuzo nesibonisi sokuzijabulisa. Ukuvela kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo akusho ukuthi abanikazi bamalungelo abafanele, izinkampani, imisebenzi, izinhlobo noma abalingiswa bezinto ezibonakalayo babamba iqhaza, bagunyaze, baxhase noma basekele le phrojekthi, futhi akusho ukuthi le phrojekthi inobudlelwano bokubambisana obusemthethweni nabo. Inhloso yokusetshenziselwa amahlaya, izinjongo zokucubungula okwesibili noma ezingenzi inzuzo azisho ukuthi imvume isitholiwe noma ukuthi ithobelana nokuhlukile kokusetshenziswa emithethweni esebenzayo.
Ukuthola amalayisense ekhodi kanye nemingcele yezinto ezibonakalayo

Izimo zokusetshenziswa kwekhodi yomthombo zingaphansi kwe-LICENSE esitolo kanye nencazelo yelayisensi yefayela elihambisanayo. Ngisho noma ikhodi yephrojekthi ngokwayo ithatha ilayisense ye-MIT, ilayisensi ayifaki ngokuzenzakalela izithombe zezinkampani zangaphandle, ama-GIF, umsindo nevidiyo, izimpawu zokuthengisa noma ezinye izinto zemidiya. Ikhodi yenkampani yangaphandle ingaphansi kwamalayisensi abo.

Le phrojekthi ayinikezi abasebenzisi imvume yokukopisha, ukujwayela, ukusabalalisa noma ukusebenzisela ukuthengisa izinto zezinkampani zangaphandle ngalesi sitatimende. Lapho kukhona ilayisense esemthethweni ehlukile noma ukugunyazwa kwempahla, leyo layisensi noma ukugunyazwa kuyobusa; lesi sitatimende asishintshi, asiselule noma sisihoxise. Ukuhlanganisa inqolobane, ukulanda amafayela noma ukuthumela iwebhusayithi akusho ukuthi usulitholile ilungelo lokusebenzisa izinto zemidiya.

Uma umnikazi wamalungelo noma umenzeli wakhe ogunyaziwe ekholelwa ukuthi okokusebenza kule phrojekthi kuhilela amalungelo akhe nezithakazelo, anganikeza impendulo ngodaba olusenqolobaneni ye-GitHub yale phrojekthi noma ngokusebenzisa imigudu yokuxhumana edalulwe umnakekeli. Ukuze kube lula ukuthola nokuqinisekisa, sicela uchaze amakhasi afanelekile, amafayela noma izinto zokwakha, amalungelo afunwayo, ubunikazi obungaqinisekiswa noma isisekelo somenzeli, kanye nendlela yokucubungula oyifunayo.

Sicela ungathumeli imininingwane yomuntu siqu ebucayi njengomazisi, ikheli, inombolo yocingo, njll. ezindabeni zomphakathi; uma udinga ukuhambisa isitifiketi esingesona esomphakathi, sicela uqale ucele umnakekeli ukuthi akunikeze ngesiteshi sokuxhumana esiyimfihlo. Le phrojekthi ngeke yenqabe ukuqinisekisa izimangalo ezinengqondo ezisekelwe "ekujikelezweni kwe-inthanethi" noma lesi sitatimende, futhi izothatha ukumiswa kokubonisa, ukushintshwa, ukususwa noma ezinye izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngokusekelwe esimweni sokuqinisekisa nemithetho esebenzayo.

Lesi sitatimende sisetshenziselwa ukuchaza imingcele yamalungelo kanye nezindlela zokuphendula zendaba. Akuyona idokhumenti egunyaziwe evela kumnikazi wamalungelo, futhi ayikona ukuzibophezela ukukhululwa esibophweni esisemthethweni. Abanakekeli banezibopho ezihambisanayo zokusebenzisa kwabo, ukukhombisa nokusabalalisa ngokuhambisana nomthetho; amalungelo athile kanye nezibopho zezinhlangano ezifanele zingaphansi kwemithetho esebenzayo, amalayisense asebenzayo kanye nezimo zangempela. Lesi sitatimende asibavimbeli noma sibavimbeli abanikazi bamalungelo ekufuneni amalungelo abo ngokuvumelana nomthetho, futhi ukususwa, ukushintshwa noma ukususwa emashalofini okulandelayo akuzisusi ngokuzenzakalelayo izikweletu ezingokomthetho eziye zavela.
